The text provides a comprehensive overview of various aspects of clinical chemistry, focusing on safety practices, accreditation, and competencies required for laboratory personnel. Additionally, the text discusses the scope of practice for clinical laboratory scientists and the significance of continuing education and certification in the continually evolving field of clinical laboratory science. Laboratory management, accreditation in laboratory medicine. Time between a specimen is received within the laboratory and the result is available (TAT) is a quality laboratory index, which affects diagnosis and treatment. It is defined as the interval between the arrival time of a sample to the laboratory and clinical validation. The aim of this study was to evaluate the TAT for stat analytical biochemistry, studying the workflow in preanalytical, analytical, postanalytical and total phases, in order to plan possible actions to improve the work procedure.
